en.headline: Hong Kong team sets record with 15 awards at WorldSkills Shanghai
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee praised the 41-strong delegation’s silver medal in rail vehicle technology and 14 medals for excellence after a reception at government headquarters.
body: Hong Kong’s largest-ever delegation to the WorldSkills Competition returned with a record 15 awards, including one silver medal and 14 medals for excellence, Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu said on Monday.

Lee met the 41 contestants who competed in 37 trades at the event in Shanghai in September at a reception at the Central Government Offices. He said the results showcased the skills and fighting spirit of the younger generation.
Gordon Tang, an MTR technician who won silver in rail vehicle technology, said the preparation had been hard but each improvement built his confidence, and he hoped to become a railway engineer.
Lee noted that vocational and professional education is a pillar of the education system and aligns with goals in Hong Kong’s first five-year plan to advance high-quality development in the sector.

zh.headline: 港隊世界技能大賽奪15獎創歷屆最佳 李家超讚揚拼搏精神
zh.dek: 行政長官周一在政府總部會見代表團，稱41名選手在37個項目中取得一銀及14個優異獎章，刷新紀錄。
body: 中國香港代表團在上海世界技能大賽取得歷屆最佳成績，共15個獎項，包括一枚銀牌及14個優異獎章。行政長官李家超周一表示。
李家超在政府總部接待41名參賽選手，他們於9月在上海角逐37個項目。他指成績展現年輕一代的優秀技能和拼搏精神。
在軌道車輛技術項目奪銀的港鐵技術員鄧光大表示，備戰過程辛苦，但每次突破都增加信心，希望成為鐵路工程師。
李家超指出，職業專才教育是香港教育體系的重要支柱，符合首個五年規劃推動職專教育高質量發展的目標。
